articles.summary: Infinity Natural Resources, Inc. ("Infinity" or the "Company") (NYSE: INR) today announced the appointment of Cary Baetz as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer and Andrew Judge as Senior Vice President of Finance, with both effective August 12, 2026. Mr. Baetz brings more than 30 years of financial leadership expertise spanning the energy, oilfield services, and industrial sectors, including a track record in capital markets execution, MA, and building and running the financial systems and processes essential for high-growth public companies at scale.
